root_cause.text: The f2fs filesystem fails to set the `FI_NO_EXTENT` inode flag during extent node destruction in `__destroy_extent_node()` and fails to check this flag for `EX_BLOCK_AGE` extent types, allowing concurrent writeback to insert new extent nodes into an extent tree that is being destroyed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `set_inode_flag(inode, FI_NO_EXTENT)` inside `__destroy_extent_node()`, and moves the `FI_NO_EXTENT` check out of the `type == EX_READ` conditional blocks in both `__may_extent_tree()` and `__update_extent_tree_range()` so that it applies to all extent types. Additionally, the CVE description details a race where concurrent writeback inserts new extent nodes during `__destroy_extent_node()` because `FI_NO_EXTENT` is not set, triggering a `f2fs_bug_on(node_cnt)`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Apply the FI_NO_EXTENT check unconditionally to all extent types in __may_extent_tree to prevent incorrect extent tree creation or access.
intent_record.what: Moved the check for the `FI_NO_EXTENT` inode flag from inside the `type == EX_READ` conditional block to the outer scope of the `__may_extent_tree` function.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any inode with the `FI_NO_EXTENT` flag set will immediately return false for all extent tree operations, rather than only restricting read-type extent operations.

intent_record.intent_summary: Set the FI_NO_EXTENT flag during extent tree destruction to prevent concurrent extent creation.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check to set the FI_NO_EXTENT flag on the inode under the extent tree write lock during destruction.
intent_record.how: It ensures the inode is marked to disable extent caching, preventing concurrent threads from inserting new extent nodes while the tree is being freed.

intent_record.how: Prevents any extent tree updates for inodes flagged with FI_NO_EXTENT by ensuring the function releases the lock and exits early regardless of the extent type.
